title: TEOS Competency
description: Machine-readable contract for one observable learner capability, its performance criteria, evidence expectations, prerequisites, and traceability.

competency_id.description: Stable identity unique within the Competency namespace.

version.description: The version of this learner-capability contract.

owner.description: The curriculum owner authoritative for this Competency.

title.description: A concise human-readable name for the capability.

description.description: The scope and context of the coherent capability.

learning_outcome.description: An observable statement of what the learner will do.

performance_criteria.description: Verifiable conditions for acceptable learner performance.

assessment_evidence.description: Evidence expectations capable of demonstrating the learning outcome.

prerequisite_competency_references.description: Version-bound Competencies that must be satisfied first.

standard_references.description: Version-bound Standards to which this Competency is mapped.

references.description: Supporting technical publications, policies, or source materials.

estimated_instructional_effort.description: A curriculum estimate of instructional effort, not a scheduled duration or guarantee.

maintainer.description: The organization responsible for maintaining this Competency.

revision_notes.description: A non-empty explanation of changes in this version.

lifecycle_status.description: The shared lifecycle state of the Competency.

metadata.description: Non-authoritative authorship, revision, and provenance metadata.

title.default: Verify an electrically safe work condition

description.default: Establish and verify safe conditions before beginning work.

learning_outcome.default: The learner verifies an electrically safe work condition using the approved procedure.

performance_criteria.default: Selects and applies the required verification procedure.

description.default: Direct observation of the complete verification procedure.
